decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (849 PL01, 849 PL02, 849 PL03, 849 PL06, Design & Access Statement Received 20/03/2012, 849 PL01A, 849 P08, 849 P12 Received 18/04/2012, 849 P07 Received 20/04/2012, 849 PL13 Received 02/05/2012, 849 PL07B Received 03/05/2012, 849 PL04A Received 09/05/2012 and 849 PL05A Received 22/05/2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the northern elevation (side dormer and lower ground level) shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The southern elevation of the glass box closest to no. 28 Burlington Road shall be fitted with Pilkington K Inner Leaf glazing with obscurity level at 80% and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with this specified glazing.
description: Erection of a single storey  rear extension at lower ground floor level, projecting glass boxes at ground floor level and side & rear roof extensions to the house.
